creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`corpus/conformance/respawn.json` uses `local/w1:p1` where the code's keys are Muster-minted (`local/p206y9p61r`). Harmless in that file, since the counting rules treat them as opaque strings.

It became misleading in `a_2KIPfvt7L`, which fixed a remedy that broke precisely because the two id spaces were confused, and which now spells them differently in every `typeable.json` case so a swap fails. A corpus file next door still spelling one the other way invites the confusion back. Cheap tidy-up.
title: 🗝️ respawn.json spells pane keys the daemon's way
